text: I signed up to receive a service from the Albert Money App soon realized it was all a scam, but there was no way to cancel service through the app. I messaged to have the service stopped. I was assured that service service would end, but after checking my account they continue to make withdrawals every month. I tried to call back they stopped making withdrawals for the month of XX/XX/2024, but started back on XX/XX/2024. This is apparently an ongoing issue with tons of people that use the service, but they make it very hard to stop service and to get your money back
